resources.string: yt-dlp is checking for more qualities. The available option can already be downloaded.
Only the player option is available. yt-dlp requires sign-in or verification. Optionally import your YouTube login cookies in the app settings, then retry. HD availability is not guaranteed.
HD lookup failed. You can retry or download the available player option.
HD engine could not start. Try sharing the video again.

Optional: select a Netscape cookies.txt file exported from your own signed-in YouTube browser session after completing any verification there. Only youtube.com cookies are kept in private app storage, excluded from backups and logs. They are sent only by yt-dlp to YouTube; this app never reads another app’s account data. Cookies grant access to your session: keep the original file private and remove it from shared storage after import. Importing does not guarantee HD access. Using an account with yt-dlp may affect that account. Clearing applies to future requests; cancel ongoing downloads first.
YouTube session: imported; validity checked on the next request
Imported. Share the video again, or retry HD lookup. Your existing app settings are unchanged.
